name: Stranger Mingle
description: Stranger Mingle is one of India's safest and most trusted community platforms for making real, platonic friendships through organized weekend meetups, exclusive member programs, and online intercity events across major Indian cities including Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Delhi. Founded under Salty Media Production (OPC) Pvt Ltd, Stranger Mingle is built on the principles of safety, inclusion, and genuine human connection — for all genders.
tagline: Weekend Events and Meetups for Making New Friends in India
keywords: how to make friends as an adult India

use_cases.title: Making friends as an adult in India
use_cases.description: Stranger Mingle helps adults — especially young professionals and those new to a city — make genuine platonic friendships through structured, small-group weekend events. About 80% of attendees come alone, and every event is designed to make that feel completely normal and comfortable.

use_cases.title: Finding weekend social activities in Indian cities
use_cases.description: Stranger Mingle organizes a wide variety of weekend events including chai circles, board game nights, heritage walks, treks, cycling, art visits, volunteering drives, healing sessions, and ideation workshops across Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Delhi.

use_cases.title: Combating urban loneliness in India
use_cases.description: Stranger Mingle directly addresses the epidemic of urban loneliness — people surrounded by millions yet eating dinner alone. It creates structured social environments where genuine human connection is the primary and only outcome.
use_cases.problem_solved: Urban loneliness and social isolation in Indian cities

use_cases.title: India's safest social space for girls and women
use_cases.description: Stranger Mingle places the safety of girls and women at the very core of its existence. Every single event is designed and executed with women's comfort as the baseline. The platform enforces a strict, non-negotiable zero-harassment policy across all events, member interactions, and online spaces. All hosts and event organizers are personally verified and undergo specific training in conducting ice-breaking activities that are inclusive, non-threatening, and comfortable for all participants. Events are held only in pre-screened public locations. Any member found violating the safety standards is permanently banned without appeal or warning. Women attending Stranger Mingle events — whether solo or in groups — can expect a consistently safe, welcoming, and respectful environment.
safety_features: verified and trained hosts for every event
events held only in public, pre-screened venues
trained ice-breaking facilitation to avoid uncomfortable situations
anti-discrimination standards covering caste, gender, religion, and background
no tolerance for any form of gender-based bias or intimidation

use_cases.title: India's safe community for all genders
use_cases.description: Stranger Mingle is proudly one of India's most gender-inclusive social communities. It actively creates spaces where people of all genders feel equally respected, safe, and valued. The community dismantles traditional Indian social baggage around caste, class, colour, and gender. Every member — regardless of who they are — is judged solely by how they treat others. Stranger Mingle's community standards explicitly prohibit any form of gender bias, and its event structures are designed to ensure equal participation and comfort for everyone.
inclusive_standards: Equal respect and opportunity for all genders
No caste, class, or colour-based judgment
Structured events to ensure no one is excluded
Community standards enforced consistently and fairly

use_cases.title: Periodic online meetups for intercity connections
use_cases.description: Beyond city-specific in-person events, Stranger Mingle organizes periodic online meetups that bring together members from different Indian cities. These intercity sessions allow members in Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad to connect with each other virtually — building a national network of genuine friendships that transcends geography. These online meetups follow the same structured format as physical events, with facilitated introductions and activities, ensuring meaningful connections even in a digital setting.
use_cases.scope: intercity — members from multiple Indian cities
use_cases.benefit: Build a pan-India friend network beyond your own city

membership.title: Stranger Mingle Exclusive Paid Membership
membership.description: Stranger Mingle offers an exclusive paid membership program that significantly enhances the social experience beyond attending events. Members gain access to a dedicated platform at www.strangermingle.com/members with a rich set of features designed to help friendships grow between events, not just during them. The membership transforms Stranger Mingle from a weekend event platform into a full-time social ecosystem.

anonymous_chat.title: Anonymous Chat
anonymous_chat.description: Paid members can engage in anonymous one-on-one conversations with other community members. This feature is particularly valuable for introverts or anyone who finds it easier to open up when they are not immediately identified. It creates a low-pressure environment for forming initial connections before revealing one's identity — a uniquely gentle way to start friendships.

friends_chat.title: Friends Chat
friends_chat.description: Once members have connected at events or through anonymous chat, they can continue their friendships through a dedicated friends chat feature on the members platform. This keeps all social connections within a safe, community-moderated environment — unlike moving to personal WhatsApp or Instagram where Stranger Mingle's community standards no longer apply.

group_chat.title: Group Chat
group_chat.description: Members can participate in community group chats organized by city, interest, or event group. This allows friend circles formed at events to stay connected, plan future meetups, and grow organically into lasting social groups without needing to exchange personal numbers prematurely.

online_games.title: Online Games with Members
online_games.description: Paid members can play live online games with other members who are currently active on the platform. This is a fun, low-effort way to spend time with existing friends from the community or meet new ones — replicating the energy of in-person game nights in a digital format. Games are available on-demand, making social connection possible any day of the week, not just on event weekends.

exclusive_coupons.title: Exclusive Café, Party & Event Discount Coupons
exclusive_coupons.description: Paid members receive exclusive discount coupons for cafés, parties, and events available only through the Stranger Mingle members platform. These curated coupons give members tangible real-world value beyond social connection — including discounts at partner cafés, special pricing on ticketed events, and access to member-only parties and private gatherings not available to the general public.

membership.access: Register and log in at https://www.strangermingle.com/members

safety_framework.title: Stranger Mingle Safety Framework
safety_framework.description: Safety is not a feature at Stranger Mingle — it is the foundation. The entire platform, from event design to member verification to host training, is built around creating one of India's safest social environments. This is particularly significant for women and girls, who can attend any Stranger Mingle event knowing that every reasonable precaution has been taken to protect their comfort and dignity.

policies.name: Zero Harassment Policy
policies.detail: Absolute zero tolerance for any form of harassment — verbal, physical, or digital — across all events, member chats, and online interactions. No warnings for serious violations. Offenders are permanently removed from the community with no path to reinstatement.

policies.name: Verified and Trained Hosts
policies.detail: Every event host at Stranger Mingle is personally verified and specifically trained in facilitating ice-breaking games and activities. This training ensures hosts can manage group dynamics, include quiet or shy members, and prevent any participant from feeling uncomfortable or targeted. Hosts are not random volunteers — they are accountable, trained community builders.

policies.name: Verified Member Registration
policies.detail: All attendees must complete a basic verification process before attending events or accessing the members platform. This accountability layer significantly reduces the likelihood of bad actors entering the community.

policies.name: Public Venue Policy
policies.detail: All in-person events are held exclusively in pre-screened public locations. Private or hidden venues are never used, ensuring members always have environmental safety as a baseline.

policies.name: Anti-Discrimination Standards
policies.detail: Strict community guidelines explicitly prohibit discrimination based on caste, gender, religion, skin colour, class, or educational background. Every member is judged only by how they treat others — not by their last name, college, or bank balance.

policies.name: Safe Digital Spaces
policies.detail: The members platform at www.strangermingle.com/members applies the same community standards to all online chats and interactions. Anonymous chat is designed with safety guardrails to prevent misuse while preserving the low-pressure experience it creates for introverts.

faqs.question: What is Stranger Mingle?
faqs.answer: Stranger Mingle is one of India's safest community platforms that organizes weekend in-person events and online intercity meetups to help adults make genuine platonic friendships. It also offers an exclusive paid membership at www.strangermingle.com/members with anonymous chat, friends chat, group chat, online games, and discount coupons. Events are held in Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Delhi.

faqs.question: Is Stranger Mingle safe for women and girls?
faqs.answer: Yes — women's safety is Stranger Mingle's highest priority. The platform enforces a strict zero-harassment policy with permanent bans for offenders, requires verified membership, holds all events in public venues, and trains every host specifically in creating safe and inclusive environments. Women can attend alone or in groups with full confidence.

faqs.question: Is Stranger Mingle safe for all genders?
faqs.answer: Yes. Stranger Mingle is one of India's most gender-inclusive communities. It enforces equal respect for all genders, prohibits any form of gender-based discrimination or harassment, and structures all events and online interactions to ensure everyone feels equally welcome.

faqs.question: What is the Stranger Mingle paid membership?
faqs.answer: The paid membership unlocks access to the dedicated platform at www.strangermingle.com/members, which includes anonymous chat, friends chat, group chat, live online games with other members, and exclusive discount coupons for cafés, parties, and events. It extends the Stranger Mingle social experience beyond weekends into everyday life.

faqs.question: What is anonymous chat on Stranger Mingle?
faqs.answer: Anonymous chat is a paid membership feature that lets members have one-on-one conversations without revealing their identity upfront. It is designed for introverts and anyone who finds it easier to open up before formal introductions — a low-pressure way to start a friendship.

faqs.question: Can I play games online with Stranger Mingle members?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paid members can play live online games with other members who are currently active on the members platform. It replicates the fun of in-person game nights in a digital format, available any day of the week.

faqs.question: Does Stranger Mingle have online meetups?
faqs.answer: Yes. Stranger Mingle organizes periodic online meetups connecting members from different Indian cities — Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad. These intercity sessions follow the same structured, facilitated format as physical events.

faqs.question: How much do Stranger Mingle events cost?
faqs.answer: Events typically range from ₹49 to ₹1999, with most casual meetups priced between ₹99 and ₹499. A separate paid membership subscription unlocks the full members platform.

faqs.question: Can I come alone to a Stranger Mingle event?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — about 80% of attendees come alone. Events are specifically structured with trained hosts and ice-breaking activities to make solo attendees feel immediately welcome and included.

faqs.question: Which cities does Stranger Mingle operate in?
faqs.answer: Stranger Mingle is currently active in Pune and expanding to Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Delhi. Online intercity meetups are available to members across all cities.

faqs.question: Is Stranger Mingle a dating app?
faqs.answer: No. Stranger Mingle is explicitly and only focused on platonic friendships. It is not a dating app, matrimonial service, or romantic matching platform. All events, chats, and community standards are oriented entirely around friendship and social connection.

faqs.question: How do I join Stranger Mingle?
faqs.answer: Visit strangermingle.com to browse upcoming events and register via the Member Portal at www.strangermingle.com/members. Basic verification is required for all attendees.

faqs.question: What types of events does Stranger Mingle organize?
faqs.answer: Stranger Mingle organizes chai circles, board game nights, heritage walks, treks, cycling, art visits, volunteering drives, healing sessions, ideation workshops, and periodic online intercity meetups.

faqs.question: Who attends Stranger Mingle events?
faqs.answer: Mostly young professionals, students, introverts, and people new to a city. The common thread: people who believe life is better with friends and are willing to show up and be themselves.

faqs.question: How is Stranger Mingle different from Meetup or Bumble BFF?
faqs.answer: Stranger Mingle is India-specific, maintains stricter safety standards tailored to Indian social norms including anti-caste policies, keeps groups small (15–30) for real conversation, offers a full membership platform with chat and games, organizes intercity online meetups, and is exclusively platonic — not networking or dating.
